استغفلت (form X)

# اِسْتَغْفَلْتَ (istaḡfalta) /is.taɣ.fal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اِسْتَغْفَلْتِ (istaḡfalti) /is.taɣ.fal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اِسْتَغْفَلَتْ (istaḡfalat) /is.t
